claim.claim-text: 1. A turbofan engine (20) comprising:
2. The turbofan engine (20) of claim 1, wherein:
said three spools comprise: a first spool comprising: a first pressure turbine (50); and a first shaft (56) coupling the first pressure turbine to the transmission;
a core spool comprising:
a combustor (45) is between the second compressor and the third pressure turbine.
3. The engine of claim 2, wherein:

the engine has an axial length L<10> between the splitter rim and the leading stage of blades of the first compressor at the inboard boundary of the core flowpath, and a ratio of said axial length L<10> to the radius R<II> is less than 1.2; and/or a ratio of the radius R<I> to the radius R<II> is greater than 0.50, and, optionally, is 0.55-1.0.
4. The engine of claim 2 or 3, wherein:
the fan blades are non-variable; and/or the engine further comprises a variable fan nozzle (35).
5. The engine of claims 2, 3 or 4, further comprising: a plurality of main bearings, wherein:

a length between said first of said main bearings and a center of gravity of a rotor of the first compressor is less than half of a disk-to-disk overall length of the first compressor; and a length between said first of said main bearings and a center of gravity of a rotor of the second spool compressor is less than a radius R<I> of the inboard boundary of the core flowpath at a leading stage of blades of the first compressor.

6. The engine of claim 5, wherein the forward hub extends forward from a disk of the first compressor, and, optionally, the forward hub extends forward from a bore (237) of the disk of the first compressor.
7. The engine of claim 6, wherein the first compressor has at least one disk forward of said disk, and, optionally:

the first compressor has at least two disks forward of said disk; and/or the static support (164') passes through said at least one disk forward of said disk; and/or said at least one disk is forward of a centerplane (526) of the second bearing.

8. The engine of any of claims 5 to 7, wherein the first bearing and the second bearing are non-thrust roller bearings, and, optionally, rollers of the first bearing and the second bearing are at least partially longitudinally overlapping.
9. The engine of any of claims 5 to 8, wherein:

a separation of a transverse centerplane (524) of the first bearing and a transverse centerplane (526) of the second bearing is less than a radius (R<B>) of the first bearing; and/or a first seal (290) seals the first bearing and a second seal (292) seals the second bearing to isolate a transmission compartment (286) ahead of the first bearing and the second bearing from a region (288) behind the first bearing and the second bearing.

10. The engine of any of claims 5 to 9, wherein a third of said main bearings is a thrust bearing (170) engaging the first spool shaft, and, optionally, a fourth of said main bearings is a non-thrust roller bearing (172) engaging an aft end of the first spool shaft.
11. The engine of any of claims 5 to 10, wherein:

the core shaft engages at least two of said main bearings, at least one of which is a thrust bearing; and/or the second spool shaft engages at least two of said main bearings, at least one of which is a thrust bearing.
12. The engine of any of claims 5 to 11, wherein:
an inter-shaft bearing (170) axially locates the first spool shaft; and/or the first spool shaft engages at least three of said main bearings.
13. The engine of any of claims 5 to 12, wherein:
the fan is a single-stage fan, and, optionally, a ring gear (82) of the transmission is mounted to rotate with the fan as a unit; and/or the first pressure turbine has three to five blade stages.
14. The engine of any of claims 5 to 13, wherein:
